summary: Every top-level cmd/vloop test now calls t.Parallel(); TestWorkedExampleB6RealData still clones HEAD and runs vloop in the clone, and now checks that HEAD and all refs of the real repository are unmoved instead of comparing git status.
verified: vloop task gate T1 equivalent (sh .vloop/state/gates/T1/gate.sh) printed gate T1: ok; go test -count=1 ./cmd/vloop/ passed; go test -race -run TestRun0 clean.
notes: No test in cmd/vloop uses Setenv/Chdir or mutates a package variable (b5Bins is mutex-guarded), so none stayed serial. The real-data test's tracked-file check is now refs-only (HEAD plus for-each-ref); a write into the real repo's tracked files is no longer detected there because the working tree legitimately changes during the run. Full ./cmd/vloop run took ~173s on this machine.
